Metadata.title: Draft Analyst
Metadata.description: Account analysis, tournament draft simulator and draft review for League of Legends.

Footer.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Riot Games or OP.GG.

Home.title: Draft Analyst
Home.subtitle: Analyze your team's accounts, simulate tournament drafts against an AI coach and review match drafts.

Team.title: Team
Team.intro: Paste a multi OP.GG link, profile links or Riot IDs (one per line or comma separated) to analyze the team's accounts.
Team.dataNotice: Data comes from OP.GG and may be outdated if the profile has not been refreshed there for a while.
Team.tooMany: Found {count} players; only the first 5 were used.
Team.empty: No Riot ID found in the text.
Team.storageUnavailable: Could not save the team in this browser.
Team.requestFailed: Could not fetch the players right now. Try again.
Team.comfortHelp: Combines games played, win rate adjusted for small samples and how recently the champion was played.

alerts.shallow_pool: Shallow pool in {role}: {count, plural, =0 {no comfortable champions} one {# comfortable champion} other {# comfortable champions}}.

errors.not_found: Player not found on OP.GG. Check the name and tag.
errors.timeout: OP.GG took too long to answer. Try refreshing.
errors.network: Could not fetch this player right now.
errors.bad_response: Could not read this player's data right now.
errors.unavailable: Could not fetch this player right now.

Analyze.title: Analyze draft
Analyze.intro: Fill in a match's bans and picks on the board (in any order) or paste the draft as text, and get a full analysis.
Analyze.pasteHelp: One line per team, picks in Top, Jungle, Mid, ADC, Support order. E.g.: Blue: Aatrox, Lee Sin, Ahri, Jinx, Thresh. Bans: "Blue bans: ...". Names in EN or PT.
Analyze.pastePlaceholder:
Blue: Aatrox, Lee Sin, Ahri, Jinx, Thresh
Red: Ornn, Vi, Orianna, Kai'Sa, Nautilus
Blue bans: Yone, Rell, Ziggs
Red bans: Skarner, Ashe, Hwei
Analyze.pasteNothing: No team found. Start the line with "Blue:" or "Red:".
Analyze.playersToggle: Enter the players (to take comfort into account)
Analyze.noSavedTeam: No saved team. Load one on the Team page.
Analyze.missingPicks: Missing picks: fill all 5 on each side.
Analyze.duplicateRoles: Each side needs a different role for each pick.
Analyze.requestFailed: Could not analyze right now. Try again.
Analyze.favored: {side} came out ahead in the draft
Analyze.phasesTitle: Who is stronger in each phase
Analyze.comfortValue: comfort {comfort} · {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}
Analyze.comfortNone: no recorded games on this champion
Analyze.aiUnavailable: AI analysis unavailable. The rule-based analysis above still applies.
Analyze.aiError: The AI analysis failed. The rule-based analysis above still applies.

Matchup.title: {a} vs {b}
Matchup.sample: {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} this patch
Matchup.noSample: Not enough games for this matchup.
Matchup.powerCurveHelp: Each champion's win rate by game length (overall in this role, not only in this matchup).
Matchup.tipsEnglish: Tips from OP.GG, available in English only.

Dev.title: Component preview
Dev.note: Development-only page to review the Phase 2 components.
Dev.teamHelp: One champion per role (Top, Jungle, Mid, ADC, Support), comma separated.

Comp.radarHelp: Sum of the team's draft attributes, 0 to 10 (10 = five champions excellent at it).

damageWarnings.full_ad: Almost all damage is physical: easy to itemize against (armor).
damageWarnings.full_ap: Almost all damage is magic: easy to itemize against (magic resist).

weaknesses.no_frontline: No frontline: nobody to absorb damage in fights.
weaknesses.no_engage: Little engage: hard to start fights.
weaknesses.low_waveclear: Low waveclear: struggles against sieges and lane pressure.
weaknesses.no_peel_for_carry: Unprotected carry: little peel for the hypercarry.
weaknesses.vulnerable_to_poke: Vulnerable to poke: little mobility against a poke team.
